commit_message_on_validation:
XFOOT, LOOKUP, SORTA and MOVEA (factor 2) of a global array based on a
pointer are lowered: the array's place resolved once, first, as each
operation's array_ref resolves it (sym's based_place for one element's
size); an element past the end of the storage the pointer addresses
read and written as load_var and store_var do (what is there then
blanks; only the part there is). A based array as MOVEA's result stays
with the interpreter. rpgcg's VERSION, left at +stage2.171 since
S2.172 by edits that did not apply, is +stage2.186 (ADR 0007's note: no
stale code ran, each validation generates its code afresh).

Verified by the native unit NBASARR under both engines, as captured on
PUB400 (tools/golden/native96.txt n96_based); none of its statements is
left with the interpreter.

Full validation on x86_64 (jsr-test-2, s7f-s2187, the snapshot with
S2.185 to S2.187): fmt, clippy (ours), debug and release tests, release
build, demo and native-diff pass. native-diff: level 2 auto 794 tests
the same as under the interpreter; level 2 rust 794 of 794 as under the
interpreter, one program refused (NATSW1, on purpose); coverage 99.3%
(native 5886, interpreter 43).
